verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird documents a 'Deal Room' secure virtual data room hosted on HighQ for client matters/documents, which addresses the core of a secure client portal/extranet, but there's no dedicated page describing matter status tracking, login/portal onboarding process, or broader extranet functionality beyond the data room mention. Missing for 10: dedicated portal/extranet landing page, description of matter status visibility, client onboarding/login process, independent corroboration of portal usage.
